data.name: Sorav
data.gender_notes: Sorav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sorav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sor' which means 'Sun' and 'Av' which means 'Ray'. The name represents the brightness and warmth of the sun's rays. The name Sorav carries the meaning “Sun's ray” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sorav usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's ray and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sorav is believed to have spiritual significance in Hinduism, representing the divine light and warmth of the Sun God.

The name Sorav embodies the positive qualities associated with the sun and could be considered a tribute to the sun god.
